Ja II 114,.18 (~ena nikkhamitvā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be cūḷa-); VI 391,.28 (ahaṃ hi ~ena nagaraṃ pavisitvā, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee cūḷa-); 459,.13 (asīti mahādvārāni catusaṭṭhi ~āni, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee cūḷa-); Dhp-a II 199,.15 (cūḷadvārāni pi pidhāya nagaraṃ uparundhatū ti); —       °-nāṭaka,   n., or ~ā, f., a group of junior dancing girls, of concubines;; Ja V 279,.10 (paṭhamaṃ tāva ekaṃ sattāhaṃ ~aṃ dhammanāṭakaṃ katvā vissajjetha, sace sā puttaṃ labhissati sādhu, noce atha majjhimanāṭakaṃ vissajjetha); (nom. ~ā; acc. ~araṃ; instr. ~arā; gen./dat. ~u, ~uno, ~ussa; voc. ~a; iic °-pitu-, °-piti-), one’s father’s brother, an uncle; an elder male relative; Ja I 387,.25 (cullamātarā ~arā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se cūḷa-); II 5,.26 (matā bhātā bhaginī cullamātā ~ā ti sabbe pi ñātakā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be cūḷa-); 393,.7 (āyasmato [Rāhulassa] … ~ā Anandatthero pitā sammāsambuddho, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se cūḷa-); III 456,.9 (rājā … amhākaṃ ṭhānantaraṃ mama ~ussa dassatī ti, Se so; Be cūḷa-; Ce, Ee petteyyassa); Mil 204,.17 (Sāriputto anekesu jātisatasahassesu bodhisattassa pitā ahosi mahāpitā ahosi ~ā ahosi bhātā ahosi …, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be cūḷa-); Sp 7,.5 (Sakyakulappasuto cāyaṃ āyasmā [Ānando] tathāgatassa bhātā cūḷapituputto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee cūla-); 470,.9 foll. eḷa:

[cf BHS aneḍa, anela], faultless; without impurity; free from phlegm; Spk I 275,.30 (aneḷagaḷāyā ti ~āya agaḷāya niddosāya c’ eva agaḷitapadavyañjanāya ca) ≠ Ud-a 313,.3; — see also nela.

ghosana:

(a) abhirami, Vin III 67,.38 (so bhikkhu ~ī ti); Ja V 95,.18 (aññāh’ eva itthīhi saddhiṃ ~i); (b) abhiramittha, D II 22,.24 (kacci … kumāro uyyānabhūmiyā ~ittha); 1 sg. abhiramiṃ, Sn 1085 (nāhaṃ tattha ~iṃ); 3 pl. abhiramiṃsu, Ja III 40,.10; — absol. abhisaṅga:

abodha:
